item.title: the case for grid systems
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:
A quick write-up on grid systems, mostly so future me stops relearning it.

why it matters

Grid systems shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • The fix that survives is the one the next person can understand.
  • Write it down once, link to it everywhere.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.

item.title: grid systems, revisited
item.author: Brenner Cruvinel
item.description:

why it matters

Grid systems shows up across design work more often than it deserves credit for. The details are small, but they compound.

what works for me

  • Optimise for the reader who shows up six months from now with no context.
  • Prefer the obvious solution; clever costs interest forever.
  • Start with the smallest thing that works, then make it boring on purpose.

None of this is a law. It is just the shape that kept working after enough mistakes.
